title: The Karnataka Municipalities and Certain Other Law (Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: 'The Karnataka Municipalities and Certain Other Law (Amendment) Bill, 2024' (Bill No. 31 of 2024) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning Municipal Administration & Urban Development. The bill introduces statutory amendments to existing state legislation, primarily modifying Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Karnataka Municipalities Act; Amendment of the Karnataka Act; It is considered necessary to amend the Karnataka Municipalities Act, 1964 across 3 identified sections/clauses.
